title: Kestrel Warehouse v2: disconnected scanner queue
summary: The Linux edition of Kestrel Warehouse v2 buffers barcode scans while disconnected.
content: Kestrel Warehouse v2 is a stockroom scanner application. Its Linux edition appends offline barcode scans to a local queue. On reconnection, the operator presses Send pending scans; the server acknowledges each batch before the local copy is removed. This note documents only Linux v2.

title: Kestrel field camera: battery service
summary: Kestrel field camera firmware v4 requires a charged battery before cleaning mode.
content: The Kestrel field camera is a wildlife camera, unrelated to warehouse inventory. Firmware v4 permits sensor cleaning only when battery charge exceeds sixty percent. Remove the lens cap before entering cleaning mode. This device does not process barcode queues.

title: Kestrel Warehouse v3 Windows deployment
summary: Kestrel Warehouse v3 for Windows requires a continuous server connection.
content: The Windows edition of Kestrel Warehouse v3 records barcode scans directly to the server. It has no disconnected scan queue. If the connection drops, scanning is paused until the server is reachable. These requirements apply to Windows v3, not the Linux v2 release.

title: 河舟观测项目：2024 年东站降水记录
summary: 河舟项目 2024 年东站采用十分钟降水采样间隔。
content: 河舟降水观测项目在 2024 年使用东站。雨量传感器每十分钟记录一次，日文件按当地时间零点分割。东站资料仅覆盖 2024 年，不包括次年的西站设备。

title: 河舟观测项目：2025 年西站降水记录
summary: 河舟项目 2025 年迁至西站，降水采样间隔为十五分钟。
content: 河舟降水观测项目自 2025 年起改用西站。新雨量传感器每十五分钟记录一次，日文件仍以当地时间零点分割。该表不能用来推定 2024 年东站的采样间隔。

title: 河舟咖啡馆：手冲配方卡
summary: 河舟咖啡馆的山地拼配手冲配方使用九十二摄氏度的水。
content: 河舟咖啡馆的山地拼配配方为十五克咖啡粉配二百四十克水，水温九十二摄氏度。先注三十克水闷蒸三十秒，再分两次注完。此处河舟是咖啡馆名，与降水观测项目无关。

title: Atlas Museum: indoor audio route
summary: The Atlas Museum indoor audio route is step-free and stays inside the building.
content: Atlas Museum offers a forty-minute indoor audio route across its ground-floor galleries. Visitors can complete the route without stairs, using the east lift where floor levels differ. Audio recordings are available in English and Mandarin. The route does not include the outdoor sculpture trail.

title: Atlas Transit: weekday tram luggage
summary: Atlas Transit weekday trams permit one cabin-sized bag that remains under the seat.
content: Atlas Transit operates the city tram service. On weekday trams each passenger may carry one cabin-sized bag, which must fit under the seat and must not block the aisle. Oversized luggage is not accepted. These rules concern transit vehicles, not Atlas Museum visits.

title: Atlas Ridge: ridge walk route
summary: The Atlas Ridge walk is an outdoor route with steep stone stairs.
content: Atlas Ridge is a two-hour outdoor walking route for experienced adult walkers. The eastern ascent includes one hundred and twenty stone steps, with no lift or ramp bypass. There is no audio guide. Atlas Ridge is not the Atlas Museum indoor route.

title: Luna 图书馆：纸质书续借
summary: Luna 图书馆纸质书可在到期前续借一次，延长十四天，但被预约的书不能续借。
content: Luna 图书馆的纸质图书借期为二十一天。在到期前办理续借可再延长十四天，每本限续借一次。若已有其他读者预约，系统不允许续借。电子书使用另一套借阅规则。

title: Luna telescope v3.1: thermal preparation
summary: The Luna telescope running firmware v3.1 needs twenty minutes to reach thermal equilibrium.
content: Before alignment, leave the Luna telescope with firmware v3.1 outdoors for twenty minutes so the tube can approach ambient temperature. Then run star alignment. This preparation card does not describe firmware upgrades, reboot procedures, or library loans.

title: Luna 图书馆：电子书到期处理
summary: Luna 图书馆电子书借期十四天，到期自动归还，不支持续借。
content: Luna 图书馆电子书每次借阅十四天，到期后自动归还，不产生逾期滞纳金。电子书不能续借；若仍需阅读，须重新排队借阅。纸质图书的续借政策不适用于电子书。

title: Peregrine starter: cool incubation batch
summary: The Peregrine starter recipe calls for a thirty-six-hour incubation at eighteen degrees Celsius.
content: For this invented Peregrine starter batch, mix equal masses of flour and water and keep the jar at eighteen degrees Celsius for thirty-six hours. Mark the starting level on the jar and loosely cover it. This recipe applies only to the cool incubation batch described here.

title: Peregrine generator: intake filter interval
summary: The Peregrine portable generator intake filter is inspected every fifty operating hours.
content: Inspect the Peregrine portable generator intake filter after each fifty operating hours. Stop the engine and allow it to cool before opening the intake cover. Peregrine here names a generator model, not the fermented starter recipe.

title: 松岚温室：夜班灯具故障通报
summary: 松岚温室夜间补光灯故障由夜班值守员接报，再通知电气维护组。
content: 松岚温室在夜班发现补光灯不亮时，先把分区编号报给夜班值守员。值守员记录故障时间并通知电气维护组；育苗人员不得自行打开灯具外壳。此卡只说明夜间灯具故障通报流程。

title: 松岚苗圃：白班幼苗补水
summary: 松岚苗圃白班按盆重检查幼苗补水需求。
content: 松岚苗圃白班人员于上午检查幼苗盆重。低于该盆记录下限时人工补水，并把时间写入养护表。本文不规定霜冻报警阈值，也没有自动喷淋控制流程；苗圃与温室灯具维护分开管理。

title: Sable Archive: monthly disconnected integrity audit
summary: Sable Archive verifies disconnected storage monthly using a stored SHA-256 inventory.
content: For the Sable Archive offline storage audit, connect the removable disk to the isolated workstation once each month. Recompute SHA-256 for every archived file and compare the values against the signed inventory stored separately. Record missing files and checksum mismatches before disconnecting the disk. No network connection is needed.

title: Sable mobile finance: temporary cache retention
summary: The Sable mobile finance app removes local preview cache after seven days.
content: Sable mobile finance keeps statement preview thumbnails in a local cache for seven days. Clearing this cache does not delete account statements on the server. This note documents preview retention only, and contains no tax-report export specification. It is unrelated to Sable Archive storage audits.

title: Brindle seminar: volunteer check-in
summary: Brindle seminar volunteers collect a blue badge from the coordinator before opening doors.
content: Volunteers working at the Brindle seminar check in with the volunteer coordinator at 08:15 and collect a blue badge. Public doors open at 09:00. The coordinator checks the volunteer roster; visitor tickets are handled at a separate desk. The Brindle workshop uses different arrangements.

title: Brindle workshop: visitor admission
summary: Brindle workshop visitors show a booking code at the west desk after 10:00.
content: Visitors to the Brindle workshop present their booking code at the west desk from 10:00 onward. Workshop visitors receive a green wristband rather than a seminar volunteer badge. This policy does not describe seminar volunteers or their check-in coordinator.

title: Cedar North shuttle: weekend bicycle rule
summary: On weekends the Cedar North shuttle accepts only folded bicycles inside a closed bag.
content: Cedar North shuttle operates the northern loop. Its weekend bicycle rule permits a folded bicycle only when packed in a closed carry bag. Unfolded bicycles are not accepted on the North weekend service. This card contains no wheelchair booking contact information.

title: Cedar South shuttle: weekday bicycle rule
summary: On weekdays the Cedar South shuttle takes unfolded bicycles on its external rack.
content: Cedar South shuttle operates the southern loop. On weekdays it accepts an unfolded bicycle on the external rack if a rack position is available. Bicycles may not be carried inside the passenger compartment. The South weekday rule differs from the North weekend folded-bicycle policy.

title: 雾桥监测点：风速探头支架
summary: 雾桥风速探头安装高度为离地三米。
content: 雾桥监测点的风速探头装在独立支架上，传感器中心离地三米。安装后用水平尺校正支架，并记录朝向。本卡没有五米安装方案，也不规定噪声传感器与墙面的距离。

title: 雾桥监测点：噪声探头防反射布设
summary: 雾桥噪声探头与最近墙面至少间隔四米，以减少反射影响。
content: 布设雾桥噪声探头时，探头中心应距离最近墙面至少四米，以减少墙面声反射。现场表须记录距离和墙面材质。这个要求是水平净距，不是风速探头的安装高度。

title: Tinfin Drawing: transparent still-image export
summary: Tinfin Drawing exports transparent still images as PNG, not SVG.
content: Tinfin Drawing is a raster drawing application. Choose PNG and enable Keep alpha to export a transparent still image. JPEG flattens the image onto a white background. The application does not offer SVG export. Tinfin Video is a separate editor.

title: Tinfin Video: ordinary clip export
summary: Tinfin Video exports edited clips as MP4 or WebM.
content: Tinfin Video exports edited ordinary video clips in MP4 and WebM containers. Choose the container in the Export clip panel and review the audio setting before saving. This product note describes ordinary clip export only and has no stereo depth-map generation feature.

title: Mosaic climate table: missing observations in validation
summary: Mosaic climate table validation keeps missing observations marked rather than filling them from a later reference table.
content: When validating the Mosaic climate observation table, preserve the missing-value marker and report a separate missing-row count. Do not copy values from the later reference table into validation rows: that would use information unavailable at observation time. The validation summary reports measured rows and missing rows separately.

title: Mosaic textile studio: dye jar labels
summary: Mosaic textile studio labels dye jars with batch date and fabric type.
content: In the Mosaic textile studio, every dye jar label records the batch date and intended fabric type. Keep cotton and wool jars on separate shelves. Mosaic here is the studio name and does not refer to climate tables or validation observations.
